Hero_Desc_Carren:
Carren is a "radical raw foodist" who believes in eating food in its raw, uncooked state.
She once led a raw food trend but fell from grace when she was revealed to be a hypocrite who adds dressing to her food.
Album_Wish_Carren: To Master the Raw Food Diet One Day
Album_Carren1: Carren is a famous ElfTuber who mainly creates content about the raw diet. They say if you have even the slightest interest in a raw diet, you couldn't possibly not know Carren's name.
Album_Carren2: Carren actually doesn't like raw food that much. I couldn't hide my bewilderment when Carren said: "Why eat ingredients raw when they taste much better grilled, fried, or boiled."
Album_Carren3: The raw food Carren hates most is carrots. Unlike other vegetables that she can force herself to eat, carrots are a no-go. However, she does like carrot cake.
Album_Carren4: Carren's reason for starting ElfTube had nothing to do with raw food. However, when one of her videos she posted during a brief raw food trend got record-breaking views, she decided to focus on that direction.
Album_Carren5: The strict rules that Elias raw food enthusiasts follow were established by Carren. Originally, even salads with dressing were considered raw food. Carren now expresses distress, saying she never knew she'd suffer from the trend she created.
Album_Carren6: Carren really benefits from Kyarot's presence because she grows enormous and magnificent vegetables that are ideal for content development. However, Carren laments that she didn't realize she would end up suffering from the very trend she created.
Album_Carren7: Carren once produced content where she forced sprites dining at restaurants to eat raw food. The response was good, but the channel almost got taken down, so she only does it very, very occasionally now.
LoveHero_Carren:
Will you teach me
a new diet?
LoveHeroCancel_Carren:
Hehe. Now I can
sneak some baked goods.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Hate1: She gives me a long lecture on how certain combination dishes could be made.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Hate2: The combination of bitter and sweet flavors seemed unfamiliar to her. She sits there for a while with a sulky expression, clearly dissatisfied.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like1: She ate them proudly, saying that even carrots could be made to be this delicious.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like2: Keeping an eye out for other sprites, she wolfed it down. Can she really go against her true nature?
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like3: She eats two bowls while saying something strange about wanting to become more of an older sister than Belita someday.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like4: Looking at me expectantly, she asks me if I could make a cake just like this but resembling a raw carrot.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like5: I see her secretly pocket some, saying it would be good to sprinkle on carrots.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like6: As she zealously eats this, she wonders aloud if filling songpyeon with carrots also would taste as good.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like7: After eating nothing but carrots for so long, she seems ecstatic after tasting this chocolate.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like8: Eating this with a determined expression, she vowed to one day grind carrots into a powder as tasty as this.
Food_ChefNote_Carren_Like9: She kept pestering me, asking me to make her carrot-shaped candy.

LoveLetter_Carren: Hello, Master. This is Carren, the former radical raw foodist. I'm sorry for behaving disgracefully in front of you last time, Master. These days, I'm no longer obsessed with ElfTube and have been living an ordinary life as a sprite. So, no need to worry about me anymore. Let's visit Kyarot's garden for some coffee next time. I'll treat you to those vegetables I promised last time, too. Until we meet again... Yours carrotly, Carren
LoveCall_Carren:
Master! It is Carren.
I was watching ElTube videos when I thought of you and decided to call.
It feels like only yesterday that I was excitedly filming raw-food videos and uploading them to ElTube. Time passes so quickly, does it not?

I felt very empty after quitting as an ElTuber, but somehow I managed to endure.
I think I overcame it thanks to your help and Kyarot's, Master.
It may be belated, but thank you so much. How can I repay you? Is there anything you need?

You do not have to answer right away. Think it over slowly and tell me when we meet next.
When should we meet? How about tomorrow at Kyarot's farm?
I will bring plenty of delicious snacks. Then I will see you tomorrow!
